requested_target: one-to-one recreation of the complete Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream
assessment: not supportable as a complete one-to-one commitment from available evidence

proposed_first_stage.scope: one apartment room, two residents, one complete everyday interaction
proposed_first_stage.camera: one reference-matched primary camera plus optional inspection orbit
proposed_first_stage.reference_baseline: must lock an official room screenshot before geometry or image generation

style_formula: Stylized three-dimensional social life simulation with oversized rounded heads, compact bodies, clean graphic facial features, simple rounded furniture, and softly shaded cartoon materials. Use warm cream interiors, pale wood, pastel accents, bright yellow and orange interface accents, and clear role-based colors. Keep a fixed front three-quarter room camera, readable silhouettes, gentle contact shadows, restrained highlights, and crisp interface spacing. Match the selected official reference frame for composition, character scale, furniture placement, and screen hierarchy.

platform.candidate_parameters: must be read from live higgsfield model get before use

generation_budget.initial_character_intent: quality smoke test before any batch
generation_budget.additional_generation: only after inspecting the first output and establishing the actual quote

acceptance: room layout and camera compared against the locked official frame
character proportion, face and hair checked from front and three-quarter
one complete interaction changes simulation state and visible behavior
save and reload preserve trial state
all referenced GLB files and animation clips reload successfully
runtime errors and rendering performance recorded
differences documented without an invented fidelity percentage
